base_fixture.normalization: fixture peak only; paired transformations may be RMS-matched where declared

cases.transform: same envelope/harmonics; carrier phases rotated deterministically
same envelope/harmonic amplitudes; root 220 Hz -> 330 Hz
same envelope/root; harmonic amplitudes changed deterministically
replace first 24 ms by steady-state continuation with 2 ms boundary crossfade; RMS-match whole fixture

decision_rule.compatibility: If v2 is promoted, retain the ValidationPolicy field and threshold but version the transient method in diagnostics/method identity; old persisted evidence keeps its historical implementation identity and is not reinterpreted.
decision_rule.edge_policy: Short/silent/near-silent cases must remain finite and deterministic; silence/activity handling may abstain through existing non-transient gates rather than fabricate transient evidence.
decision_rule.primary: Prefer v2 only if all preserved non-edge controls are accepted at threshold 0.4 and every deliberately damaged non-edge case is rejected by transient_loss or another unchanged hard engineering gate.
decision_rule.secondary: Record baseline and candidate raw values for every case; do not tune the threshold after inspecting this matrix.

methods.description: Existing target raw-derivative anchors; candidate/target derivative-RMS ratio.

Target anchors from positive rise of a 2 ms RMS envelope. At each anchor, compute normalized RMS-envelope attack rise over 1/2/4 ms smoothing; candidate-to-target ratio uses the strongest surviving scale, and gate aggregation takes the minimum across target anchors and physical channels.

purpose: Pre-registered engineering validation of inverse-search transient-preservation gating; not a perceptual or preference metric.
